description: Synthetic enterprise glossary seed for the Amaze for CM PoC: security master and pricing elements. Definitions are written for this project. No real identifier values, vendor names or vendor field codes.

elements.name: Instrument ID
elements.definition: Internal identifier that Amaze assigns to each instrument; stable for the life of the instrument and never reused.

elements.name: ISIN
elements.definition: International Securities Identification Number (ISO 6166): a 12-character code made of a two-letter country prefix, nine alphanumeric characters and a check digit.

elements.name: CUSIP
elements.definition: Nine-character identifier for securities issued mainly in the United States and Canada: a six-character issuer code, a two-character issue code and a check digit.

elements.name: SEDOL
elements.definition: Seven-character identifier for securities traded mainly in the United Kingdom and Ireland, ending in a check digit.

elements.name: FIGI
elements.definition: Financial Instrument Global Identifier: a 12-character open identifier that can name an instrument at listing, composite or share-class level.

elements.name: Instrument name
elements.definition: Full descriptive name of the instrument, as shown to users.

elements.name: Asset class
elements.definition: Broad category of the instrument, for example equity, fixed income, fund or derivative.

elements.name: Instrument type
elements.definition: Specific type of the instrument within its asset class, for example common share, government bond or exchange-traded fund.

elements.name: Issuer name
elements.definition: Legal name of the entity that issued the instrument.

elements.name: Issuer LEI
elements.definition: Legal Entity Identifier of the issuer (ISO 17442): a 20-character code.

elements.name: Currency
elements.definition: Currency in which the instrument is denominated, as a three-letter ISO 4217 code.

elements.name: Country of risk
elements.definition: Country whose economic and political conditions most affect the instrument, as a two-letter ISO 3166 code.

elements.name: Exchange MIC
elements.definition: Market Identifier Code (ISO 10383) of the trading venue where the instrument is listed.

elements.name: Ticker
elements.definition: Short trading symbol of the instrument on its listing venue.

elements.name: Issue date
elements.definition: Date on which the instrument was first issued.

elements.name: Maturity date
elements.definition: Date on which the principal of a debt instrument is due to be repaid; empty for instruments without a maturity.

elements.name: Coupon rate
elements.definition: Annual interest rate paid on a debt instrument, as a percentage of its face value.

elements.name: Lot size
elements.definition: Minimum number of units in which the instrument can be traded.

elements.name: Instrument status
elements.definition: Lifecycle status of the instrument, for example active, suspended, matured or delisted.

elements.name: Price date
elements.definition: Business date to which the price applies.

elements.name: Close price
elements.definition: Last traded price of the instrument at the end of the trading day.

elements.name: Open price
elements.definition: First traded price of the instrument at the start of the trading day.

elements.name: High price
elements.definition: Highest traded price of the instrument during the trading day.

elements.name: Low price
elements.definition: Lowest traded price of the instrument during the trading day.

elements.name: Bid price
elements.definition: Best price a buyer was prepared to pay at the time the price was taken.

elements.name: Ask price
elements.definition: Best price a seller was prepared to accept at the time the price was taken.

elements.name: Mid price
elements.definition: Average of the bid price and the ask price.

elements.name: Volume
elements.definition: Number of units of the instrument traded during the trading day.

elements.name: Price currency
elements.definition: Currency in which the price is quoted, as a three-letter ISO 4217 code.

elements.name: Price source
elements.definition: Where the price came from, such as the trading venue, a contributed quote or an evaluated price, recorded as an internal source code.

elements.name: Price type
elements.definition: Kind of price, for example traded, quoted, evaluated or net asset value.

elements.name: Accrued interest
elements.definition: Interest earned on a debt instrument since its last coupon payment and not yet paid.

elements.name: Yield to maturity
elements.definition: Annual return of a debt instrument if bought at the current price and held to maturity, as a percentage.
